release.changelog:
App Manager v4.1.1 improves permissions, installation, ADB connectivity, and several other parts of the application. Visit Settings > About > Version/Changelog for details.

**Revoke Internet Permission**
App Manager can now block internet for individual applications utilizing the eBPF rules in root or ADB mode. To block internet for an application, go to the "Uses permissions" tab and click on the toggle button next to `android.permission.INTERNET` to revoke the permission.
  
_Known Limitation._ The eBPF rules are lost after a reboot. App Manager attempts to restore the rules right after a reboot. However, in ADB mode, it might take a while to connect to wireless debugging depending on the availability of a Wi-Fi connection. This might allow applications that start after a reboot to use internet.  

**Others**
- Added support for editing `.bat` files  
- Improved installation reliability and performance  
- Improved permission management  
- Improved ADB pairing, connections, and mode handling  
- Improved settings transitions and startup messages  
- Fixed displaying profiles after creating a profile for the first time  
- Fixed intercepting browser URLs  
- Fixed listing applications on Android 17  
- Fixed title ordering in What's New dialog.  

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MuntashirAkon/AppManager/compare/v4.1.0...v4.1.1

Users are advised to update as soon as is convenient.

---

# All

- Addressed an oversight which allowed specially-crafted CIA files to execute arbitrary code in the host environment when locally installed by a user. | @PabloMK7 #2648

- Added a new 3GX loader flag `allow_homebrew_load`, which allows loading 3GX plugins for homebrew apps if the plugin supports it. | @PabloMK7 #2649

# Desktop

- Various improvements to GDB and RPC servers, fixing certain issues and improving functionality. | @PabloMK7 #2631, #2640, #2633
  - For additional info, see individual PR descriptions.
  - Script developers will need to update the RPC client as this is a breaking change. 

# Android

- Fixed a crash which could occur if the `gpu_drivers` directory contained a subdirectory. | @ygordreyer #2592

# Technical

- Creating a copy of the kernel shared and config pages using svcMapProcessMemoryEx is now possible.

Budget about 3 GB for the runtime and 1.1 GB more for the desktop, and turn off "Restrict child processes" in Developer options before the first launch. Steam is Valve's proprietary client and needs an account; frame generation needs your own copy of Lossless Scaling. The project has no website: the APK comes from its GitHub releases.

release.changelog:
### New
- **Single and Batch capture modes.** Single (the default) sends every shot through the crop screen before it's saved. Batch works like 3.0. Switch between them above the shutter or in Settings.
- **Turn off live document detection** (#124). A switch on the camera screen and in Settings gives you a plain camera. Corners are still suggested afterwards on the crop screen.
- **Sideways pages come out upright.** Pages shot with the phone held sideways are stored the right way up. The camera's icons turn to show the sideways hold was detected.
- **The export sheet says where your file went,** and tells you plainly if it had to save to the app's private storage instead.
- **Spanish and Simplified Chinese translations** (Chinese by @yk1234f), plus strings that were missing in other languages.

### Improved
- **Sharper scans.** Pages are captured at the camera's full resolution (e.g. 12.5MP instead of 1280×720) and processed in about half a second. Exports are much sharper. Pages are larger, about 0.65MB each.
- **Auto-capture is off by default.** It's a switch in the top bar, and a ring fills around the shutter as it counts down.
- **Cleaner capture screen.** One guidance line at the top of the viewfinder instead of pop-up messages over the shutter, and a 4:3 viewfinder without dark bands. In Batch mode, a thumbnail of the last page shows how many pages you've taken.
- **Back from the camera keeps your pages** instead of discarding them.
- **Hold a page to select it.** Reordering has moved to ⋮ → Reorder pages.
- **The crop screen opens immediately** after the shutter.

### Fixed
- **Less memory use with long documents** (#107). Page thumbnails are loaded at the size they're shown instead of at full resolution, so long documents no longer run low-memory phones out of memory. A 60-page document now peaks at 260MB instead of 727MB.
- The crop magnifier no longer slides off screen near the image edges.
- The crop screen's corners are placed correctly

- 摘要支持分区配置、独立标题、启用状态和对话回顾设置
